title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 04, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.2 (Peaked November 04, 2026 at 06:54 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 423 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The Sun is about 93 million miles away. That's quite a commute. 🌞

A broad dark coronal feature is prominent today, alongside several bright active regions and only small visible sunspot groups.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
